beverageStyle.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.

unit.label: Unit
unit.rule: g and ml only; not free text.

materialType.label: Material Type
materialType.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.

currency.label: Currency
currency.rule: Only MYR at launch. More currencies may be added later; there is no currency conversion.

language.label: Language
language.rule: English and Simplified Chinese enabled. Malay later.

RawMaterials.title: Raw Material
RawMaterials.intro: Shared purchased materials and packaging. Prices count toward drink cost only after Admin approval.
RawMaterials.noAccess: Only Managers and Admins can view raw materials and prices.
RawMaterials.name: Name
RawMaterials.approvalsIntro: Check the details and cost, then approve or return with a reason. Nothing changes until you approve.

form.name: Name
form.specificationHint: Only what tells this product apart, e.g. Full cream.
form.priceHint: Leave blank if unknown; the cost will show as incomplete, never as zero. Enter 0 only for free items.
form.coffeeBean: Coffee bean (used in Daily Coffee Calibration)
form.packInvalid: Pack size must be greater than 0
form.priceMissingNote: No price yet: cost will be incomplete.
form.matchesHint: Use the existing material. For a different pack size, open it and add a pack.

detail.notEditable: Submitted and approved materials can't be edited here. Use a price change or a new pack instead.
detail.pendingNote: Packs and prices are approved together with the material.
detail.recipes: {count, plural, =0 {No approved recipes} one {# approved recipe} other {# approved recipes}}

priceChange.notice: This creates a price proposal. The current approved price stays in effect until Admin approves.
priceChange.affected: {count, plural, =0 {No approved recipes use this yet.} one {Affects # approved recipe.} other {Affects # approved recipes.}}

addPack.note: The new pack is sent for approval. The costing pack stays the same.

Recipes.intro: Create, copy and revise outlet recipes. Admin approves before a version goes live.
Recipes.staffIntro: Official SOPs on your outlet's published menus.
Recipes.staffEmpty: No published SOP for your outlet yet.
Recipes.createIntro: Start a new draft for one of your outlets. The outlet can't be changed later; copy the recipe instead.
Recipes.catalogueNote: Approved recipes from every outlet. Copying creates an independent draft for your outlet; it still needs approval and does not put the drink on a menu.
Recipes.noApprovedYet: No approved version yet. Staff will see the SOP after Admin approves it.
Recipes.deleteDraftConfirm: Delete this draft? This can't be undone.
Recipes.photoRules: 1 to {max} photos of the finished drink. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.
Recipes.photoSize: Each photo must be 10 MB or smaller.
Recipes.uploadFailed: Upload failed; your other changes are kept.
Recipes.tasteHint: Leave blank if not assessed; 0 is a score.
Recipes.conflict: Someone else saved this draft. Reload to see their changes before saving again.

errors.PHOTO_REQUIRED: Add at least one finished photo
errors.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: Prep Material can't depend on itself
errors.COST_INCOMPLETE: Cost is incomplete, so this can't be approved:
errors.COST_UNAVAILABLE: Cost calculation isn't installed yet, so approval is blocked.

Recipes.nothingToReview: No version is waiting for approval.

Recipes.menusAffected: Published menus that switch to this version

Recipes.approveConfirm: Approving makes this version live immediately.
Recipes.approveDrinks: These drinks' cost and SOP change: {drinks}.
Recipes.prepDependenciesHint: For each, use an existing Prep of the target outlet or copy it as a new draft. Copied Prep must be approved before the drink.

Recipes.duplicateName: This outlet already has a recipe with this name.
Recipes.noCopyTargets: You don't manage another outlet to copy into.

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.note: Choose a report. Managers see their own outlets; Admins see all outlets.
Reports.noAccess: Reports are available to Managers and Admins only.

cost.title: Cost Report
cost.summary: Cost, selling price, gross margin and cost rate of approved drinks.
cost.note: Approved recipes of your outlets, with cost per drink and margin against the live menu price.
cost.currentExplain: Current estimate: today's approved purchase prices; Prep Material follows its latest approved version.
cost.snapshotExplain: Snapshot at approval: prices saved when the version was approved. The two can differ when prices change.

rnd.title: R&D Report
rnd.summary: Recipe versions with change summary, tasting notes, flavour and cost change.
rnd.note: Recipe versions of your outlets. Copies in other outlets are separate recipes.
rnd.basis: Snapshot at approval (prices at the time)
rnd.costExplain: Cost and change use each version's snapshot at approval, so a price rise also shows as a cost change.

menus.title: Menu Summary
menus.summary: Each menu's status, drinks, prices, current cost and data problems.
menus.note: Menus of your outlets with their live drinks. No sales data (no POS).
menus.costExplain: Cost is today's estimate. Prices are the live menu prices; unpublished changes are not included.
